name: Xiantao Municipal Big Data Center Machine Room Project
developer: Xiantao Municipal Big Data Center
notes: Listed in Xiantao's 14th Five-Year new infrastructure plan as the city big data center machine-room construction project, with power, cooling, fire-protection, security, cabling, cloud-platform and other room systems proposed at the public security bureau buildings 8 and 9.

name: Xiantao New-Generation Government Cloud / City Operations Center Machine Room
developer: Xiantao municipal government
notes: Hubei Daily reported an operational Xiantao city-operations-center room running dozens of domestic-CPU servers, more than 80 government systems and about 2 billion data records; small civic cloud facility rather than hyperscale IDC.

name: Dawu Artificial Intelligence Computing Center
developer: Unspecified project investor with Dawu County support
notes: Hubei Science and Technology Department said the project landed in Dawu County Economic Experimental Development Zone; planned investment CNY 260 million, phase-one CNY 100 million, 200 data cabinets, up to 3,000 servers, 8,000T storage, T3-grade standard, plus 10MW rooftop PV and 10MW/20MWh storage.

name: Xiaogan Yunqi Computing Power Project
developer: Xiaogan Yunqi Data Technology Co., Ltd.
notes: Reported as filed on Oct. 22, 2025 in Xiaogan High-Tech Development Zone; total investment about CNY 300 million, 500 sqm, 128 NVIDIA H200 servers, construction Dec. 2025-Mar. 2026, planned to serve Ningbo Unicom.

name: Yangtze 3D Scientific Computing Center / Xiaogan Computing Power Industrial Park
developer: Xiaogan Gaocuang Investment Co., Ltd. / Lianguang Yuanhe (Xiaogan) Optical Technology Co., Ltd.
notes: Xinhua Hubei reported the first CNY 300 million phase was completed in May 2023 as part of the CNY 11.2 billion Xiaogan computing industrial park; C114 described the project as a MaPU-based 3D scientific-computing cluster with about 110P compute.

name: Three Gorges Dongyuemiao Data Center
developer: China Three Gorges Corp / Three Gorges Hi-Tech
notes: Green hydro-powered data center at the right bank of Three Gorges Dam. Phase one was completed/commissioned with about 4,400-4,416 cabinets; full plan is 5 data-center buildings and 26,400 cabinets. Three Gorges Hi-Tech current page advertises hosting plus GPU compute services.

name: Dianjun District Artificial Intelligence Computing Center
developer: Yichang Dianjun District / Enflame Technology ecosystem
notes: Hubei Data Bureau described Yichang's large-scale compute cluster; the Dianjun AI computing project has total investment about CNY 300 million and uses domestic AI compute. Yeez case page says it is a heterogeneous intelligent computing center serving smart-city, culture/tourism, finance and education workloads.

name: National Advanced Computing Industry Innovation Center (Yichang)
developer: Sugon / Yichang Dianjun District partners
notes: CNR reported three Dianjun compute centers lit up and described this project as CNY 3.02 billion, EPC+O delivery, planned overall completion in 2025 and 500P mixed compute at full buildout.

name: City Cloud Changde Data Center
developer: Hunan City Cloud Big Data Industry Development Co., Ltd.
notes: Opened in Changde Economic Development Zone on Sept. 22, 2024. Government source describes a national A-grade data center, 10,000 sqm, 1,000 server cabinets, planned 2,000P delivery, phase-one investment CNY 350 million and 500P delivered.

name: Changde Langhe Big Data Center
developer: Langhe / Changde High-Tech Zone project company
notes: Changde Daily/Huasheng reported an Oct. 30, 2023 groundbreaking in Changde High-Tech Zone; total expected investment CNY 1.88 billion, three phases, about 10,000 8kW cabinets, expected annual output CNY 1.2 billion after full completion.

name: China Telecom Tianyi Cloud Central-South Digital Industrial Park
developer: China Telecom / Tianyi Cloud
notes: Major Changsha Tianxin project. Hunan MIIT reported groundbreaking as part of three digital projects with Tianyi Cloud investment of CNY 12 billion. Hunan action plan says about 300 mu, 280,000 sqm, 22 buildings, planned 21,128 standard racks, 692.32 PFLOPS and 2,641PB storage.

name: China Unicom Changsha Cloud Data Center
developer: China Unicom Hunan
notes: Hunan compute-capability action plan identifies this as Unicom's largest Central-South cloud data center and a five-star facility; 3,200 standard racks planned, 1,633.6 built at the time, 104.86 PFLOPS design compute and 400PB design storage.

name: National Supercomputing Center in Changsha
developer: Hunan Province / Hunan University / National University of Defense Technology
notes: National supercomputing facility in Changsha. MOST described the center startup in 2014; Hunan government reported in 2025 that the Tianhe next-generation host reaches 200P Flops peak performance and 1000P Flops AI compute.

name: Changsha 5A Intelligent Computing Center
developer: Changsha AI computing-center operators / local digital economy partners
notes: China.com.cn reported Hunan's first 5A intelligent computing center was unveiled online in Changsha, using a 1+N platform model to provide compute services, algorithm innovation and ecosystem aggregation.

name: China Unicom Hengyang Big Data Center
developer: China Unicom Hengyang Branch
notes: Hengyang Natural Resources and Planning Bureau issued completion acceptance notice in 2024. Trade/source coverage says project is in Hengyang High-Tech Zone, started June 2021, with approximately CNY 300 million current-phase investment and about 26 mu planned land.

name: Hengyang County Big Data Intelligent Computing Center
developer: Hengyang County Data Bureau
notes: Reported FSR approval by Hengyang County Development and Reform Bureau on Jan. 26, 2025. Project code 2411-430421-04-01-420396, investment CNY 189 million, Xidu Town Yingnan New District, with IDC rooms, digital rooms, compute resource pool, 20 CPU servers and 180T high-speed storage.

name: Huaihua Cloud Computing Center
developer: Huaihua municipal government / city cloud operators
notes: Huaihua implementation opinion says all government compute infrastructure should be coordinated around Huaihua Cloud Computing Center, with other existing data centers consolidated into it by the end of 2025; target by 2025 is 1,000 standard racks, 30 PFLOPS compute and 20PB storage.

name: Hunan Mobile Loudi 5G Cloud Data Center
developer: China Mobile Hunan / Loudi Mobile
notes: Rednet reported groundbreaking of a CNY 350 million project on 16,700 sqm; phase one includes a production dispatch building with 5G core room and big-data room, intended as Loudi's largest 5G cloud data operations center.

name: Loudi Municipal Data Center / Government Cloud System
developer: Loudi Data Bureau and local government-cloud providers
notes: Rednet cited Loudi MIIT saying the city had built five data centers totaling 179 standard racks and 10PLOPS compute; Hunan MIIT later described a government cloud plus police cloud, carrier public cloud and Xianggu big-data-center computing-infrastructure system.

name: Dongjiang Lake Big Data Industrial Park / Green Data Valley
developer: Zixing/Chenzhou governments with Hunan Telecom, Hunan Yunchao Technology and park operators
notes: Large Chenzhou/Zixing data-center cluster using Dongjiang Lake cold-water resources. Government and industry sources describe a 3.3 sq km-plus / 5,000 mu park, planned CNY 50 billion investment, up to 200,000 racks and 5 million servers. By 2026, five data-center projects had landed, serving 74 enterprises with about 700 PFLOPS aggregate compute.

name: Yunchao Dongjiang Lake Big Data Center
developer: Hunan Telecom / Hunan Yunchao Technology Co., Ltd.
notes: Flagship operational data center in Dongjiang Lake park. Hunan government described it as built and operated by Hunan Telecom and Hunan Yunchao; county-government coverage says the Yunchao center had about 3,600 operating racks and 80% rack utilization.

name: Yixin Technology (Yeqi) No. 2 Data Center
developer: Yixin Technology / Yeqi
notes: County-government article on Dongjiang Lake Green Data Valley says Yixin Technology (Yeqi) No. 2 building data center had been completed as one of the park's landed projects.

name: Chenzhou City Investment Dongjiang Lake No. 2 and No. 3 Data Centers
developer: Chenzhou City Investment / local state-owned platform
notes: County-government article reports City Investment No. 2 and No. 3 building data centers had been completed in Dongjiang Lake Big Data Industrial Park.

name: Xinchi Computing Power Center
developer: Xinchi / Dongjiang Lake park partners
notes: County-government article says Xinchi Computing Power Center was among Dongjiang Lake park data-center projects about to start construction.

name: China Unicom Dongjiang Lake Big Data Center
developer: China Unicom
notes: County-government article says China Unicom Dongjiang Lake Big Data Center was among the park projects about to start construction.
